scope: Read-only source qualification against classic-gtim-input-evidence.json. No tests, builds, harnesses or hardware operations performed by this reviewer.
result: No remaining register-mode, acknowledgement, pin-direction, ownership, fixed-ARR, or start-mode blocker found after the ICR correction. Both documentation clarifications are resolved in the final authored implementation.

corrected_finding.issue: New capture and underflow acknowledgements originally used zero-default PAC ICR writes, changing reserved reset-one bits 8:7.
corrected_finding.resolution: Both now seed pac::gtim::regs::Icr::write_noop(), set only the intended typed flag false, and perform one write_value. Verified against generated no-op seed 0x3ff and own-manual ICR reset/reserved semantics.

observations: Classic QEI fixed reload 65535 validation happens before timer configuration.
Classic input_start modifies only EN, retaining ENCMODE programmed immediately before it.
Classic QEI leaves CMMR captures disabled, matching own manual and SDK encoder initialization.
Timer reset/init clears CR0 auxiliary modes including L052 XOR/capture reset, disables interrupts/DMA, clears flags and resets CNT before pins connect.
Capture uses correct CMMR 1/2/3 encodings, typed CCR reads and explicit separate W0C acknowledgements; classic exposes no fabricated overcapture API.
Classic filters match all own-family tables and polarity is non-inverted.
Both capture and QEI select per-instance SYSCTRL channel mux 0 before connecting pins.
AF input connection passes output=false, enables digital input and leaves the output driver disabled.
QEI Div1 produces PSC 0 or PRS 0, consistent with reset-state encoder sequence; no programmable QEI prescaling is exposed.
QEI has distinct OV and UD access/clear paths; reading DIR is independent and non-atomic with CNT.
Drop stops timer before disconnecting inputs and delegates clock-gate shutdown to owned inner Timer.
The enclosing build.rs peripheral loop excludes the time-driver timer before every pin-trait emission.

Classic source catalog requires own-family evidence, expected register contracts, instance set, hash-pinned route source, and a match against already qualified package-bonded CH route before CAP promotion.

resolved_documentation_notes.finding: Module documentation now says no overcapture flag is documented, matching documentary scope.
QEI documentation now distinguishes classic up-wrap OV and down-wrap UD while explaining that coalesced flags cannot reconstruct the count or ordering of missed wraps.

final_refresh.scope: Refreshed the reviewed implementation file hashes and confirmed the two wording corrections only. Source evidence was not changed; source research, tests and builds were not repeated.
